subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The project must be completed ________ the end of the week.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. by .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence indicates a deadline for the project.
 
• The word **“by”** is commonly used to specify the time limit within which an action must be completed.
 
• **“By”** is appropriate as it suggests that the project must be finished before or at the end of the week.
 
• Other options such as “on,” “at,” and “in” do not convey the correct meaning in the context of a deadline.

Correct sentence: *The project must be completed **by** the end of the week*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Usage of Prepositions:**

 
 
• **On:** Refers to specific days or dates. Example: The meeting is on Friday.
 
• **At:** Refers to specific points of time. Example: The train arrives at 5 PM.
 
• **In:** Refers to a period of time within which something occurs. Example: He will finish the work in two days.
